iommus.reason: ADT ane node names no phandle for iommu-parent; the DART sibling is the iommu parent (see dart).

dart_phandle_field.reason: ADT ane node in 27.0 (j433 et al) has no iommu-parent field; the T8122 DART sibling 'dart-ane' is on a separate node path with a 0x311800000+0x4000 base.

sid.reason: T8110 DART instance field captured in 13.5 detail (line 'sid = 64424509440' on dart-ane j180d); the T8122 detail ADT was summarized not full-parsed (the receipt script condenses), so the T8122 sid byte string is not in the lab notebook. The T8110 family sid value for ANE (sids 40961 in T8103/T6000; the T8110/T6020/T6021/T6030 family uses a different encoding per the T6020 detail 0x28e084000..0x28e084033 dapf-instance-0 byte range that is identical in shape to T6020/T6021) is consistent across the T8110 family. Field is present in ADT but the receipt script did not preserve it. Re-extract the T8122 ADT detail with the same script used for j180d to obtain the sid byte string. Not verified.

page_size.src: S1 (inferred from T8110 family: T8110/T6020/T6021/T6030 all share the T8110 DART compatible; T6020 dart detail 'page-size = 16384' from adt-13.5-ane.txt)

compatible.reason: no ane-mailbox node in the ADT; the ascwrap-v6 mailbox is the second reg window 0x311050000+0x4000 (matches apple,t6031-asc-mailbox + apple,asc-mailbox-v4 from kernel dtsi S4). Compatible name not in ADT — inferred from aurora S4.

interrupts.src: S1 (the 5 interrupts of the ane node, ordered as in ADT: the 506/508/509/507/524 set is a best-guess mapping to the 4 doorbells + the ane ring; not directly labelled in the summary. Need full ADT re-extraction.)

ane_cpu_count.reason: ANE_BASE has only one TD-driven child; T8122 is M3 base, single ANE. T6030 has ANE_BASE+ANE_MPM+ANE_CPU+ANE_TD as separate parents; T8122 collapses the four into one parent 'ANE_BASE < ANE_TD, ANE_CPU'.

size.src: S2 (im4p wrapper, fetched via HTTP range; receipt r27.fetch.log line 'firmware Firmware/ane/h15_ane_fw_themis_j51y.im4p 1605657')

sha256.reason: im4p wrapper not unwrapped; the payload-after-im4p hash is not in the lab notebook for the M3 case. The M2 (t602x_ane0_fw_selene_rc4x) hash a9c4b771… is published in ane/t6021 source (driver sha-pin), but the M3 fw is fetched on demand via omarchy-ane-firmware-fetch; its payload sha256 is computed by the fetch script and stored, not by this run.

format.src: S2 (im4p is the Apple firmware wrapper, decrypted to an ANEC container)

encrypted.src: S2 (im4p is the encrypted form; omarchy-ane-firmware-fetch decrypts via the manifest key)

loaded_by.reason: BuildManifest key 'IsFUDFirmware' (FUD = firmware update daemon) is true on M3 family per receipt log; the M2 selene was FUD-loaded by iBoot on the 13.5 stub. Whether the M3 themis image can be hosted on Linux without FUD requires the BuildManifest key + the ANE-class firmware path; not verified in this run.

class.reason: macOS 27.0 26A428 kernelcache not fetched; the kext binary name is the AppleHxxANEInterface family (T6001 = AppleH11ANEInterface per AneQosMap artifact; the M3 class is presumably AppleH15ANEInterface or AppleH15ANEIn — see AneQosMap pattern). Not verified.

protocol.reason: kext strings not extracted this run; the M2 kext exposes CSNE_CMD_* and ANEProgramLegacyResource class symbols (T8112/22G74 kext: 6.602.1). The M3 kext is the same family but possibly with ascwrap-v6 mailbox doorbells. Not verified.
